Automatic login to VIT hostel Wi-Fi, from your Mac's menu bar. Needs macOS 15 or later; works on Apple silicon and Intel Macs.

## Install

1. Download **WiFiConnector.dmg** below and open it.
2. Drag **WiFiConnector** onto **Applications**.
3. Open WiFiConnector from Applications. macOS says it can't verify the app, because it isn't signed with a paid Apple Developer ID. Click **Done**.
4. Open **System Settings ▸ Privacy & Security**, scroll down, and click **Open Anyway** next to WiFiConnector. Confirm with your Mac password. You only do this once.
5. Click the Wi-Fi icon that appears in the menu bar:
   - **Settings…**: enter your registration number and Wi-Fi password, then **Save**.
   - **Install Background Agent**: this is what logs you in automatically.
   - **Start at Login**: so the icon comes back after a restart.

The app is open source. You can read every line it runs at https://github.com/anujbajaj4/wificonnector.
